newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ionics to assemble computer parts for TDK.
newsitem.headline: Ionics to assemble computer parts for TDK.

text.p: Ionics Circuits Inc said on Monday it had signed a manufacturing and assembly contract with the local unit of TDK Corp of Japan to assemble magnetic heads.
Vice president Bonifacio Domingo told the Philippine Stock Exchange that Ionics would assemble magnetic heads for Component Manufacturers of TDK Corp for three years.
The contract has an annual renewal option after the three-year period.
"The construction of the additional facilities that are needed in setting up the line is expected to be completed by July 1997, and is expected commence soon after," Domingo said.
The new facility will be funded through internally generated funds.
No other details were available since the company is bound by the confidentiality clause in its agreement, Domingo added.
